title: ballota hispanica subsp. mollissima
intro: Ballota hispanica subsp. mollissima, commonly known as Sweet Golden Rod, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ballota hispanica subsp. mollissima include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, carminative, and expectorant, making it useful for relieving symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
